summary: Midland States Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing its board approved an amendment to increase its stock repurchase authorization from $25 million to $45 million and extended the program's expiration to December 31, 2026. As of the filing, the company had already repurchased 923,837 shares at an average price of $21.46, totaling $19.8 million of the original authorization. The program is subject to market conditions, corporate and regulatory requirements, and may be suspended or discontinued at any time. Watch for future buyback execution pace and any Rule 10b5-1 plan amendments as indicators of management's view on valuation.
